title: Closed geodesics in short intervals for random hyperbolic surfaces
summary: We study the distribution of closed geodesics in short intervals on random hyperbolic surfaces of large genus, and compare it with the classical problem of primes in short intervals. Viewing the surface $M$ as a random point in moduli space equipped with the Weil--Petersson measure, we investigate the random variable $Ψ_M(x;H)$ counting closed geodesics with norms in the interval $[X, X+H]$, weighted by primitive length, where $H=o(X)$.
